properties.name: A0092/26 / FIMP
properties.originalText:
EBOLA VIRUS DISEASE (EVD) PUBLIC HEALTH MEASURES APPLICABLE TO 
AIR TRAVEL TO MAURITIUS PURSUANT TO THE PUBLIC HEALTH ACT AND IN 
ACCORDANCE WITH THE MEASURES IMPLEMENTED BY THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH 
AND WELLNESS OF THE REPUBLIC OF MAURITIUS, THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS 
SHALL APPLY TO FLIGHT CREW ARRIVING IN MAURITIUS. FOR THE PURPOSE OF 
THIS NOTAM, FLIGHT CREW INCLUDES CABIN CREW 
 
1. FLIGHT CREW ARRIVING IN MAURITIUS AND WHO: 
A. HAS DEPARTED FROM, TRAVELLED TO, OR TRANSITED THROUGH THE 
DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO OR SOUTH SUDAN DURING THE PRECEDING 
TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS OR 
B. HAS BEEN PRESENT IN ANY OF THE ABOVE-MENTIONED COUNTRIES DURING 
THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS, EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN PARAGRAPHS 
3 AND 4 BELOW SHALL BE REFUSED ADMISSION INTO MAURITIUS. 
2. MAURITIAN FLIGHT CREW AND AIR MAURITIUS FOREIGN CREW WHO HAVE 
DEPARTED FROM, TRAVELLED TO, OR TRANSITED THROUGH THE DEMOCRATIC 
REPUBLIC OF CONGO OR SOUTH SUDAN DURING THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) 
DAYS SHALL BE SUBJECT TO QUARANTINE, MEDICAL ASSESSMENT AND 
MONITORING BY THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND WELLNESS. 
3. THE ABOVE RESTRICTION DOES NOT APPLY TO QUICK TURNAROUND FLIGHT 
CREW WHO DO NOT DISEMBARK IN MAURITIUS. 
4. THE ABOVE RESTRICTION DOES NOT APPLY TO TRANSIT POSITIONING FLIGHT 
CREW WHO ONLY TRANSIT IN THE TERMINAL BUILDING SUBJECT TO FLIGHT CREW 
NOT INVOLVED IN SERVING FLIGHTS TO COUNTRIES MENTIONED AT PARAGRAPH 
1A DURING THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS. IF ATTENDING RESTRICTED 
COUNTRIES, FLIGHT CREW INVOLVED SHALL BE PLACED IN ISOLATION ROOM 
PRIOR TO DEPARTURE. 
 
COMPLETE AND PRESENT THE PRESCRIBED ALL-IN-ONE HEALTH DECLARATION 
FORM PRIOR TO BOARDING. 
6. AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL ENSURE STRICT COMPLIANCE WITH THE ABOVE 
REQUIREMENTS REGARDING FLIGHT CREW AND ENSURE THAT AIR MAURITIUS 
FOREIGN CREWS OPERATING IN MAURITIUS HAVE THE NECESSARY VALID 
PERMITS. 
7. ISOLATION AND PUBLIC HEALTH RESPONSE PROCEDURES FOR SUSPECTED 
CASES SHALL BE IMPLEMENTED IN COORDINATION WITH THE MINISTRY OF 
HEALTH AND WELLNESS. 
8. THIS NOTAM REMAINS IN FORCE UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.)
